name: Influenza
description: A contagious acute respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses. Uncomplicated disease often has abrupt onset with fever or chills, myalgia, headache, malaise, cough, sore throat and rhinitis, although fever may be absent.
associated_symptoms: Vomiting or diarrhea, particularly in children
risk_factors: Other conditions associated with increased risk of severe influenza
physical_examination: Assessment for hypoxemia or lower respiratory tract involvement
recommended_investigations: Influenza molecular testing when results would affect clinical management
Influenza testing for patients hospitalized with suspected influenza
Multiplex respiratory viral testing when clinically appropriate
Chest imaging when pneumonia or another lower respiratory complication is suspected
contraindications: Do not delay clinically indicated antiviral treatment in hospitalized or high-risk patients solely while awaiting influenza test results.
Antibiotics do not treat uncomplicated viral influenza.
